decisions.reason: The plug-in line extends the core data integration business at low marginal cost and has its own page, so it likely meets aspirations and gives no trigger for search.
The building digital twin service is still only mentioned and its results are uncertain, but slack from industry growth lets the firm keep exploring this emerging market a while longer.
The authentication delegation service is close to the core and cheap to carry, though after E's withdrawal it may be consolidated, so the risk is somewhat elevated.
The open GIS framework is central to the firm's open, extensible component strategy and supports its project business.
The consulting workshop is newly launched with its own page, draws on existing expertise at low cost, and feeds project business, so there is no reason to drop it yet.
